mechanism: Fixed-cost entry threshold with immediate exit; lumpy 8-seat providers; contemporaneous entry & exit (no lag); one-period installation lock
key_parameters: N=100; 30 public seats; 4x8 private seats; tuition 2.0, varcost 1.0; F_low=$4 (bk 4), F_high=$8 (bk 8=cap); premium 1.00,+-0.20,+-0.20,1.00; 200 seeds
key_result: A_high=1.0338 vs A_low=1.0254, diff 0.0083 (rule >=0.25); exit seats 9.80 vs entry 9.48; applications 85.66->100 (censored up)/62.64
council_judgement: Strongest negative in the battery: a fixed cost buys discreteness/level shift, not asymmetry; but near-symmetry is close to by-construction (symmetric threshold, symmetric shock, contemporaneous decisions, censored up-shock)
artefact_flag: informative design constraint (negative; partly constructed null)
note: Do not licence a 'hysteresis parameter'; needs a second asymmetric friction. Source: cluster_A/FINDINGS.md s1; verdicts.json exp1

mechanism: Public seat expansion with private providers exiting whole if post-expansion customers < break-even; comparative statics, demand not shocked
key_parameters: cap=15 x 2 providers; F_high=$15 (bk 15=cap), F_low=$4, F_mid=$12 sensitivity; public 30->50 and 38->39; cap30/M1 replication; premium 4.0; 200 seeds
verdict: PASS on a thin margin (T2a 0.486<0.50; T2b 0.708; T2c 0.685)
council_judgement: Most decision-relevant mechanism: the object is net of private exit; magnitude is arithmetic (R=1-exit_share*lost/gross), a mixture not an elasticity; F=$12 would have failed
note: A 14-seed swing flips T2a; all-or-nothing exit + bk=cap are load-bearing. Source: FINDINGS s2; verdicts.json exp2; recomputed 9.725/20=0.48625

mechanism: Entry lag L in {0,2,4} between order and installed capacity; temporary (4-period) vs permanent boom; exit immediate; installation lock

key_result: peak vacancy L=4 temporary 8.08 (rule >=8.0, margin 0.08), 0.00 at L=0/2 and all permanent cells; peak backlog 10.89; admissions 603.52/584.60/567.06; steady state t=7 vs 6
verdict: PASS on a thin margin (T3a 8.08; T3b; T3c 0.00<4.0)

key_result: HC true output 1.498/1.585/1.585; SG true output 0.499/0.627/0.796 (rises); SG applications 85.85/28.45/0.00; composition gaps 44.82 (v=.5) / 45.85 (v=1)

mechanism: Fixed older-diploma group vs fixed treated young set; skill_upgrade adds +1.0 skill, rank_upgrade grants queue priority with all young ranked above older-diploma holders
key_parameters: 100 people; older 20; treated 20; fixed jobs ~U{35..40} / responsive J=100; extreme rank rule; +1.0 skill; 500 seeds
key_result: older hires rank 0.00 vs reference 7.61 vs skill 4.38; output rank 0.6608 / ref 0.8080 / skill 1.2126; responsive gap 0.200, allocation component ~5.6e-17; attenuation 63.8%
verdict: T5.1/T5.2/T5.3 PASS; T5.4 NOT MET; D5.5/D5.6 PASS

mechanism: Two-stage screening: gate (retained/repealed) x ranking (credential visible/blind); 35 offers; credential independent of true skill
key_parameters: 100 applicants; 35 offers; credential shares 45/55 main, 25/75 sensitivity; zero credential-skill correlation; 500 seeds
key_result: uncred offer rate: visible/repealed 0.000, blind/repealed 0.350, blind/retained 0.000; c25 visible/repealed 0.133; 10 vacancies in c25 gate-retained
verdict: T6.1 NOT MET; T6.2 PASS; T6.3 PASS; T6.4 NOT MET; F6 not triggered
council_judgement: Gate and visibility are complements; a one-lever credential policy is a null by construction (45 credentialed >= 35 offers); blind result forced by zero credential-skill correlation
note: Design lesson: joint lever required; a single-lever null is uninformative. Source: FINDINGS s3; summary.json exp6

mechanism: De jure law L x declared enforcement e; norm effect 0.010 and register-only effect 0.10; e multiplies attendance pressure and verified learning; work displaced by attendance
key_parameters: N=120; delta_norm=0.010; delta_enf=0.35; reg_norm=0.10; reg_enf=0.30; thresholds 0.55/0.60/0.70; work retention 0.60; 200 seeds

council_judgement: Measurement warning with real force: register compliance overstates the behavioural effect ~9x, so C4 must measure de facto enforcement; 'law alone inert' depends on delta_norm=0.010 and the e x L null is built-in

mechanism: PV-equal seat expansion (40 discount-0.97 seat-years per level) into one level at a time or all at once; endogenous backlog-rationed construction; one gate per cohort
key_parameters: N=120; 30 cohorts; delta=0.97; 40 seat-years/level; seat0=(18,0,0); 240 seeds
key_result: crossings M0/M1/M2/M3: control 10/31/27/31; primary_first 4/16/12/17; upper_first 10/13/15/21; simultaneous 6/13/14/19; S 11-13 in every arm; paired S diff 0.0; upper completions 1077 (upper_first) vs 1428.5 (primary_first)
verdict: PARTIAL: P10-1, P10-3 met; P10-2b and P10-2c fail; INTERVAL 13 not in [2,12]

note: Source: FINDINGS s1.1-1.2; RESULTS.csv P10 rows

mechanism: Permanent cohort size n in {96,120,144} x capacity rule frozen (absolute seats) vs responsive (seats per child); fixed 3 seats/cohort investment
key_parameters: 3 seats/cohort; seat0=(18,0,0); employer per-child invariant; 240 seeds
key_result: X_M0 neutral 15, up_frozen 19, down_frozen 11, responsive all 15; completion/child 0.772/0.688/0.819; DiD +4.0 years (240/240); M1 censored in every cell
council_judgement: Near-tautological: under responsive capacity seats per child are identical by construction, so 'no effect' is arithmetic; cite only as a definition - a demographic shock is only a shock when capacity fails to scale
note: 240/240 sign consistency is arithmetic, not a p-value. Source: FINDINGS s2; PRE_DECLARATIONS s6.3

verdict: PARTIAL: P12-1a/1b/3 met; P12-2a and P12-2b fail
